title: api: schema versioning — deprecations, beta headers, and backcompat shims for streaming/function-calls/structured-output
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Context: This PR introduces a lightweight API schema versioning layer to support a staged rollout for new request/response shapes used by streaming, tool/function-calling, and structured_output. Motivation: we need a way to evolve the surface while maintaining OpenAI-compatibility and avoiding client breakage during rollout. Goals: (1) add an opt-in beta header (X-Redwood-API-Version: beta/2026-02) so clients can opt into new shapes, (2) land backward-compatibility shims server-side so older clients continue to work without header, (3) deprecate legacy fields with clear warnings in responses and logs, and (4) add tests + migration docs for SDKs and the OpenAI compatibility layer. What changed (high-level): - New header parsing and enforcement in api gateway: when header present and value starts with "beta/" the request/response pipeline will parse and emit the new schema; otherwise we keep legacy behavior + shims. - Streaming: added dual-format streamer that emits both legacy-chunk envelopes and the new "structured_chunk" envelope when header is set. Server-side shims will translate new structured output into legacy deltas for older clients. - Function/tool-calling: request/response shapes updated to support typed parameter schemas and invocation metadata; added a compatibility shim that maps new "tool_invocation" to legacy "function_call" shape when header is absent. - Structured output: added top-level "structured_output" object for deterministic parsing and validation when beta header enabled; legacy "content/annotations" fields are still emitted for compatibility. - OpenAI-compat layer: updated compatibility layer to attach beta header when client requests explicit "schema_version":"beta" param; improved mapping rules and added warning logging for deprecated fields. - SDK updates: Python and TS SDKs updated to offer opt-in helpers to set the beta header and to parse both new and legacy shapes. - Docs and migration guide: new doc under /docs/api/schema_versioning with examples and suggested migration checklist. Rollout strategy: header-guarded beta + server-side shims to avoid immediate breaking changes; feature-flagged rollout (50% internal traffic -> gradual increase) and monitoring hooks for schema mismatch metrics. Tests/CI: added unit tests for parsing, stream-edge cases (empty chunks, trailing newline delimiting), integration tests for tool-calling mappings, and golden fixtures for structured_output. CI initially failed on flaky streaming test (streamer/test_stream_backcompat flaky on macOS runners) — reran and all checks passed. Checklist: - [x] header parsing and validate tests - [x] dual-format streaming implementation - [x] function/tool-call mapping + tests - [x] SDK helpers + docs - [x] deprecation warnings and telemetry - [x] migration docs and changelog Notes on compatibility and deprecations: - No customers will be forced to opt into beta; the header is opt-in. - Deprecation warnings will be surfaced in response headers (X-Redwood-Deprecation-Warn) and in Console when clients call legacy fields. - We considered throwing on schema mismatches but chose to log and emit deprecation warnings to reduce incidents. Review/Conversation Summary: - Aisha: requested additional unit tests around simultaneous streaming + function-call invocation. Added tests and fixed race in streaming buffer zeroing. - Derrick: asked that the OpenAI-compat layer not rewrite request ids; adjusted mapping to preserve client-provided request_id. - Maya: security review for header parsing and potential header injection; added strict header validation and whitelisting in gateway. - CI: initial flaky test fixed by adding a short deterministic backoff in test harness. Approvals: Approved by Aisha Khan and Derrick Zhou after addressing comments. Merge notes: squashed commits, bump feature flag start state to off, documented rollout plan in PR body. Commits: see commit_summary below.
commit_summary: feat(api): add X-Redwood-API-Version beta header parsing and gating
feat(streaming): dual-format streamer for legacy and structured_chunk envelopes
feat(compat): map new tool_invocation -> function_call for legacy clients
chore(sdk): add beta header helpers and parsing helpers in python and ts
test: add streaming backcompat integration tests and golden fixtures
docs: add schema_versioning migration guide and examples
fix(streaming): race condition in streaming buffer zeroing (test flaky)
release_notes: Add opt-in schema versioning (X-Redwood-API-Version). New structured_output and typed tool_invocation shapes are available under beta header. Server will continue to emit legacy fields for backward compatibility. SDKs updated with opt-in helpers. Deprecation warnings will be emitted; no automatic client breakage. See docs/api/schema_versioning for migration steps.
notes: Migration guidance included; recommended customer-facing changelog and emailed migration notification to active customers using legacy tool_call shapes. Monitoring: added metric schema.mismatch.count and alert playbook entry in SLO toolkit.
